name: get_unchecked_mut
declaration: const unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut (self) -> & 'a mut T
documentation:
Gets a mutable reference to the data inside of this `Pin`.

 # Safety

 This function is unsafe. You must guarantee that you will never move
 the data out of the mutable reference you receive when you call this
 function, so that the invariants on the `Pin` type can be upheld.

 If the underlying data is `Unpin`, `Pin::get_mut` should be used
 instead.
rules: You must never move the data out of the mutable reference returned by `Pin::get_unchecked_mut`.
